init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed training mode for SLURM multi-GPU or single GPU jobs using params object
init_signal_handler: install SLURM signal handlers to handle job pre-emption and time limit SIGUSR1 signals
sig_handler: handle SLURM SIGUSR1 signal by logging process info and requeuing the job on the main process
term_handler: handle SIGTERM signal by logging and bypassing termination for graceful SLURM job shutdown
review_init_distributed_mode: review the init_distributed_mode function to understand SLURM multi-node and torch.distributed.launch setup
